newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to up.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to up.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb lower to 0.100 higher while CME feeder cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.150 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

Analysts were divided on the direction of live cattle futures, especially with evening up ahead of the weekend and Friday afternoon's Hogs and Pigs report. Technical resistance was evident in August above 64.000 cents and this may also influence the market, they said.
Lower boxed beef values again Thursday will limit any support in the nearby, they added.

Feeder cattle futues were expected to show further strength following the run up to new contract highs Thursday and a continued rising CME feeder cattle index. The index and futures both moved up to 22 month highs on Thursday's rally, analysts said.
Futures are showing a technical breakout but may run into profit taking, especially ahead of the weekend, they said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.10 at $78.44 per cwt, a new high for the move and highest price level since August 18, 1994.
